description: This file defines an enumeration 'TrackingAreaSupport' with a static method 'resetMouseTracking' that manages NSTrackingArea objects for an NSView, allowing for resetting mouse tracking areas.

classes.name: TrackingAreaSupport
classes.description: An enum providing support functions for managing tracking areas within views.

methods.name: resetMouseTracking
methods.description: Resets the mouse tracking area for a given view by removing the existing tracking area if present and adding a new one with specified options.
